written: 2026-11-18, before the batch results or the backtest were seen
summary: The system runs in shadow mode beside Riya's own triage for six intake weeks or 100 applications, whichever is later. Riya keeps triaging as today; the system's read is compared with hers and with the partners' calls. It graduates to first reader (Riya reads only what it flags, plus a random 10% of its suggested passes) only if every threshold below holds. Any single fabricated fact or missed portfolio conflict stops it immediately. Even after graduation it never decides: every outcome still goes to Kushal.

metrics.how: Of applications the partners take a call on during shadow mode, the share the system had marked 'Suggest pass'. This is the costly error: a good founder never reaching a partner.
metrics.threshold: 0 of the first 20 calls; at most 5% overall
metrics.if_breached: System may not suggest 'pass' at all; it ranks only, and Riya reads everything.
metrics.current: Not measured yet: shadow mode has not started

metrics.metric: Agreement with Riya on call / no call
metrics.how: Share of applications where the system's 'take the call' matches Riya's. Reported with a 95% interval. Every disagreement is reviewed and logged as 'Riya right', 'system right' or 'unclear'.
metrics.if_breached: Extend shadow mode; review the corrections log for a systematic miss.
metrics.current: Not measured yet: needs Riya's own reads of this batch

metrics.how: Weekly spot-check of 20 random claims: does the cited source actually say it? A fabrication is a claim whose source does not contain it, or a source that does not exist.
metrics.if_breached: Stop. Nothing goes to partners until the cause is found and fixed.
metrics.current: None found mechanically: 298/298 deck/form quotes and 63/68 web quotes re-found. 5 web pages block scripts; the human 20-claim spot-check is not done yet

metrics.how: Same spot-check: share of claims the cited source fully supports (partial support counts as a miss). Plus the mechanical audit: every deck/form quote found in the file.
metrics.if_breached: Fix the research prompt; re-run that week.
metrics.current: 470/470 claims cite a source; 100% deck/form quotes verified; 93% of web quotes re-found by script

metrics.how: Seeded test set (Talkbook vs MeetRecord, plus five synthetic overlaps with other portfolio companies) and every real overlap Riya spots in shadow mode.
metrics.if_breached: Stop. Expand the conflict families and the portfolio descriptions.
metrics.current: 1/1 real case (Talkbook vs MeetRecord) caught by both the code check and the scorer; synthetic set not built yet

metrics.how: In the spot-check, any founder background or metric presented as known when it was not established.
metrics.current: 75 gaps named; 0 of 19 founders had a findable footprint and all 19 are reported as gaps, none as facts

metrics.how: When a later application matches a correction's tags, did the score card cite and apply it (precedents_applied)?
metrics.if_breached: Tighten the tags on corrections; make retrieval stricter.
metrics.current: Seeded corrections applied in 4 score cards (C004 on 3 lenders, C002 on Pumpwise); reuse test passes

metrics.how: Blind re-score of the 12 deal memos (decision and reasoning withheld). Agreement = 'take the call' on invested companies and anything else on passes. Every disagreement adjudicated in writing.
metrics.threshold: >= 9 of 12, and no investment the fund made scored 'suggest pass'
metrics.if_breached: Do not start shadow mode; rework the revealed thesis.
metrics.current: FAILS: 8/12. Investments marked pass: 1 under the pre-registered rule (ePlane), 0 under rule v2

metrics.how: Minutes per application, logged by Riya during shadow mode, for applications where she accepts the system's read.
metrics.if_breached: The system is not saving time; find out which section she is redoing.

where_it_breaks.why: The fund's deciding signals (does the founder own the risk? get defensive? answer 'what would make you quit?' with a milestone?) appear in calls, not decks. In the backtest, removing the partners' founder assessment is the cleanest measure of how much of the decision lives there.
where_it_breaks.mitigation: R1 and R6 carry low confidence from an application alone; call questions are generated to test them; Kushal and Riya's call notes feed corrections.

where_it_breaks.why: Web research can confirm what exists, not what doesn't. A thin footprint is reported as a gap, never as a negative, but it means the founder criteria rest on founder-stated facts.
where_it_breaks.mitigation: Gaps are listed with the exact question to ask; footprint is shown per founder.

where_it_breaks.why: The revealed lens is reconstructed from 12 memos, so it describes what the fund rewarded, and it will lag if the fund changes. The stated lens describes public wording, which already lags (Riya's observation).
where_it_breaks.mitigation: Both lenses are shown with the gap between them; the thesis file is versioned and re-derived each quarter from new memos and corrections.

where_it_breaks.where: Categories the fund has never decided on
where_it_breaks.why: Healthcare delivery, travel, and other categories with no precedent in the memos have no revealed-thesis evidence; scores there are extrapolation.
where_it_breaks.mitigation: Flagged as sector-label stretch (G3); route to a partner, not to a pass.

where_it_breaks.why: The system cannot judge whether the technology works. Aditya's rule: deeptech second calls are not delegated.
where_it_breaks.mitigation: Deeptech always adds Aditya to the call; technical claims are marked founder_stated.

where_it_breaks.why: Twelve decisions give a wide confidence interval, the revealed lens is in-sample on those twelve, and six of the companies are real and well known (the scorer may recognise them).
where_it_breaks.mitigation: Treat the backtest as a smoke test; shadow mode on new applications is the real test.

where_it_breaks.why: Kushal: written rules turn into checklists and founders learn to pass them.
where_it_breaks.mitigation: The thesis file and prompts stay internal; scores weigh evidence (numbers, named customers, contradictions), which is harder to perform than language.

status: Not ready for shadow mode on its pre-agreed terms: the backtest bar (>= 9/12) is missed. All misses are cautious (no pass the fund rejected was advanced). Recommended next step: shadow mode with the system restricted to ranking, 'screen first' and gate-based passes (rule v2), and a second backtest on the Ledgerly notes and the next quarter's decisions.
